description: Test vectors for JSONC parsing — JSON with // line comments, /* block */ comments, and trailing commas. Comment markers and commas inside string literals MUST be preserved. All three ports (python, rust, typescript) parse `input` and must produce `expected`.

vectors.name: trailing-line-comment
vectors.description: A // comment after a value is removed

vectors.name: multiline-block-comment
vectors.description: A multi-line block comment is removed

vectors.name: trailing-comma-object
vectors.description: A trailing comma before } is removed

vectors.name: trailing-comma-array
vectors.description: A trailing comma before ] is removed

vectors.name: trailing-comma-with-whitespace
vectors.description: A trailing comma followed by newline/whitespace before } is removed

vectors.name: comment-markers-in-string
vectors.description: // and /* */ inside string literals are NOT comments

vectors.name: mongo-uri-double-slash
vectors.description: mongodb:// scheme inside a string is preserved

vectors.name: escaped-quote-in-string
vectors.description: An escaped quote does not end the string; following // stays literal

vectors.name: comma-in-string-before-brace
vectors.description: A comma inside a string is not a trailing comma

vectors.name: realistic-config
vectors.description: A realistic annotated config with mixed comments and a trailing comma

vectors.name: plain-json-unchanged
vectors.description: Plain JSON with no comments parses unchanged
